overview: Tea mosquito bug adults and nymphs feed on buds, young leaves, and tender stems. Feeding punctures may appear reddish-brown and leaves may curl.
symptoms: Leaves may curl or deform; shoots may dry
favorable_conditions: TNAU reports greater damage in more shaded areas
management: Use locally approved integrated pest-management guidance; do not choose pesticide from the image alone
